ABOUT THESE BUILDS

A home for your own work.

These are your personal reconstructed builds of The Farmer Was Replaced, using the installed game's runtime and resources. This build library is separate from the publisher's release.

Keep Steam installed and signed in for the existing Steam integration. The renamed builds retain their own save folders, separate from the original game.

Installation & save locations +

Mac

Open the DMG and copy The Farmer Was Replaced.app to Applications. If an app with that name already exists there, keep both instead of replacing your original installation.

~/Library/Application Support/FarmerReplica

Windows

Extract all files together and open Launch The Farmer Was Replaced.cmd. Keep the EXE, data folder, and DLLs beside the launcher.

%LOCALAPPDATA%\FarmerReplica
